title: Assembly Metadata Update Pipeline
description: Nextflow pipeline to fetch new assemblies, retrieve their metadata from NCBI, and determine which existing assemblies in the Ensembl metadata database require an update.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should save output data.

output_dir.description: Path to the output directory where results will be saved.

assembly_options.title: Assembly options
assembly_options.description: Options controlling which assemblies are screened for updates.

screen_date.description: Custom date to retrieve assemblies released after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Required unless --gca_input is set; mutually exclusive with --gca_input.

gca_input.description: When true, uses the GCA list provided via --gca_list as input instead of fetching assemblies from the metadata database. Mutually exclusive with --screen_date.

gca_list.description: Path to a file containing a list of GCA accessions to process. Requires --gca_input.

ncbi_options.title: NCBI options
ncbi_options.description: Options for the NCBI Datasets API.

ncbi_url.description: Base URL for the NCBI Datasets API.

database_options.title: Database options
database_options.description: Options for the metadata database connection.

metadata_params.description: Path to the JSON file containing metadata database connection parameters (host, user, password, port, database).

db_table_conf.description: Path to the JSON file describing how each metadata database table should be updated (method, delete key, update key).

slack_options.title: Slack reporting options
slack_options.description: Options controlling Slack notifications sent to genebuilders when an assembly's metadata changes.

slack_report.description: When true, sends a Slack direct message to the genebuilder assigned to an assembly whenever its metadata is updated.

slack_user.description: Path to the JSON file mapping genebuilder usernames to Slack user IDs. Requires --slack_report.

slack_params.description: JSON string with Slack bot connection parameters, e.g. '{"slack_bot_token": "xoxb-..."}'. Requires --slack_report.

metadata_params_string.description: JSON string (rather than file path) with the metadata database connection parameters, used when sending Slack reports. Requires --slack_report.
